identity.fantasy: A fast glaive fighter who builds Felfury, turns critical strikes into off-hand cleave, and rushes between targets with demonic momentum.
identity.one_line: A fast glaive fighter who builds Felfury, turns critical strikes into off-hand cleave, and rushes between targets with demonic momentum. The defining decision is contextual: Crits, resource level, and target count continually alter the next useful action.

mechanics.core_loop: A fast, crit-driven glaive fighter. It generates Felfury, spends it on Azzinoth's Assault, uses charges and Chaos Rush to stay active, and turns critical strikes into off-hand cleave. Recent builds emphasize very high AoE potential and good mobility.
mechanics.single_target: Generate Felfury through the crit-driven glaive kit, spend through Azzinoth's Assault, and keep the passive demon-form upkeep from falling away. Players describe an every-global, high-APM loop, but no source gives a reproducible exact priority.
mechanics.aoe: The leading build claims extremely high AoE potential, while players note that dungeons often collapse into constant AoE spending. Neither source quantifies target thresholds or a pack sequence.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Charges and Chaos Rush provide excellent contact tools and contribute to the spec's high execution pace.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Annihilan Strike, Azzinoth's Rage, Fel Blades, You Cheat, Gul'dan!, Scars of the Past.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Azzinoth's Assault, Annihilan Strike, Twin Fury, Reckless Assault, Felguard.

failure_modes.text: Capping Felfury, dropping demon-form upkeep, or wasting a charge breaks a loop players describe as continuously active.
